transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the Battalion S-4. We've got four pallets arriving at 0830 today -- water-treatment chemicals, refrigerated medical cold packs, generator air filters, and battery modules -- and I need to get a receiving plan approved before unloading can begin. Let me hear your updates so we can get the right pallets assigned to the right storage areas. We have the ventilated chemical shed, the medical cold room, the secure parts cage, and the covered outbound staging bay available. Who wants to start?
